title: The forbidden reef: one night off North Sentinel
logline: A solo sailor's yacht drifts onto the reef of the world's most isolated island at night and must survive without going ashore.
essence: Surviving the forbidden reef means never stepping onto the beach.

hero.name: the sailor
hero.description: A solo sailor on a small yacht
hero.flaw: Alone, without power, and forbidden to go ashore.

hook.visual: The yacht heels on the reef at night; torches move on the beach behind the hero at the helm.

core_question.text: How do you survive the night without going ashore?

stakes.physical: A grounded hull on a falling tide.
stakes.legal_ethical: Contact with the island is forbidden.
stakes.mortal: The island's people turn every visitor back.

spine.once_upon_a_time: A solo sailor crosses the Andaman Sea.
spine.every_day: The yacht holds its course far from the island.
because_of_that: Because of that, the current drags the yacht to the reef.
Because of that, the sailor must wait aboard in the dark.
spine.until_finally: The beacon brings a patrol boat at dawn.
spine.ever_since: The sailor gives the island a wide berth.

beats.summary: A patrol boat at dawn; never going ashore is the answer.
